subject: general
question: Who among the following is known as the architect of Indian planning?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis OBE, FNA, FASc, FRS (29 June 1893– 28 June 1972) was an **Indian scientist and statistician**.
 
• Born to an academically oriented family, Mahalanobis pursued his early **education in Calcutta** (now Kolkata).
 
• After graduating with **honors in physics** from **Presidency College**, Calcutta, **in 1912**, he moved to England **to study** physics and mathematics at the **University of Cambridge**.
 
• Mahalanobis held several national and international portfolios. He served as the **chairman of the United Nations Sub-Commission** on Sampling from **1947 to 1951** and was appointed the **honorary statistical** adviser to the **government of India in 1949**.
 
• He served on the **Planning Commission of India** from 1955 to 1967, where he applied his **mathematical reasoning** to Indian industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis was an **eminent statistician**, best known for founding the **Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) in 1932**.
 
• Dr. Mahalanobis made several contributions to the field of statistics, including the **‘Mahalanobis distance’**, a statistical measure.
 
• He also developed the **Feldman-Mahalanobis model**, a **Neo-Marxian model of economic development**, which was employed in the Second Five Year Plan of India, which promoted rapid industrialization of the country.
 
• He was also conferred with several awards including the **Padma Vibhushan**.
